facts.text: Dospělí jedinci přenášejí pulce do louží stojaté vody.
facts.quote: When the eggs hatch, the adult frogs carry the tadpoles to pools of still water.

facts.text: Žije v nadmořské výšce mezi 100 a 1800 metry.
facts.quote: This frog has been observed between 100 and 1800 meters above sea level.
